meta_state_law_citations_007.answer:
The Board and the Association agree that all negotiable items that should or could have been discussed during negotiations leading to this Agreement, were discussed, and that this Agreement represents all items agreed to and that no additional negotiations, unless stipulated in this Agreement, or required by Chapter 447, Part II, Florida Statutes, will be conducted during the life of this Agreement except by mutual consent of the Parties.
The 2013-2014 Salary Schedule becomes the grandfathered salary schedule pursuant to Fla. Stat.§ 1012.22(1)(c)(1)(b).
Pursuant to Fla. Stat. §1012.22, any employee moving from the grandfathered salary schedule to the new performance salary schedule will maintain the annual base salary he/she was being paid from the grandfathered salary.
The Parties recognize that the Florida Legislature enacted and the Governor signed into law Senate Bill 2986 during the 2004 Legislative Session.
Notwithstanding Article III, Section B 1 (a) of the parties' Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) and only for the duration of this Memorandum of Understanding (MOU), in keeping with the provisions of Fla. Stat. § 1011.62 (1) & (9), the aforementioned Parties agree that the District may extend the contractual duty day of selected bargaining unit employees by one (1) hour during the 2013-2014 school year.
If any additional elementary schools are designated by FDOE for the 2013-2014 school year per Fla. Stat. § 1011.62 (l) & (9), employees at those additional District elementary schools also will have an extended contractual duty day of one hour for the 2013-2014 school year.
All efforts will be made to conduct any additional professional development and in-service activities that are determined by the District to be necessary as a result of Fla. Stat. § l 011.62 (1) and (9), during already scheduled Professional Development Days (PDDs) (elementary early release days), during already scheduled Elementary In-Service Days and/or on regular duty days per the adopted 2013-2014 School Calendar.
